title: Speech summarizes by default and reads exactly when the task requires it
problemCues: Assistant speaks about numbers, policies, or form values on screen
preconditions: Visible artifact remains available independently of narration
decision: Default to concise spoken summary with the artifact on screen. Allow exact reading when the user asks or when accuracy of a specific value is the task. Do not treat brief-summary guidance as a universal ban on verbatim speech.
tradeoffs: Exact reading is slower; summary risks omitting a critical value
exceptions: Captions and transcripts must still expose the full content for accessibility
example: Alexis reading a selected KPI on request
validatedBy: Scenario matrix includes summarize vs exact-read requests without losing the artifact
